spots.line: The floor is swept. Somebody did that, and it was one of you.
Marks on the doorframe where somebody measured a child, years back.
A shelf of things nobody has thrown out and nobody uses.

chests.line: The box under the floorboard. Still where you left it.

people.name: Merrow the Housekeeper
chatter: I kept it aired. You were gone long enough for it to matter.
There's bread, if you can call it that by now.
Somebody came asking after you. I said I didn't know, which was true.
The bed's better than it was. You paid for that, so use it.
